body:
CODEX STORYATLAS MOCKUP REPAIR — FRESH IMMUTABLE CANDIDATE READY FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW

Identity and scope

- Actor: codex-storyatlas-root.
- Candidate: cand-3CM1JDY29SG3WPSV74GVS08WNF.
- Commit: dda53463a1556f1b18bfd8a24c937d439fc89dfc.
- Tree: 7fd21caf66b562c48c635ba38844ad00ffd7303b.
- Direct base: 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5.
- Scope remains only mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2.
- The shared main branch remains at the base commit. Nothing was landed, authorized, or pushed. The two blocked candidates and their reviews remain immutable evidence.

What changed after the formal blocks

Implementation I2b is repaired. For every exact-evidence item, the browser court now traverses every clipping ancestor through the artboard, computes cumulative visible bounds, and requires meaningful visibility after scrolling against the scroll viewport, every outer clipping ancestor, and the artboard. A one-pixel outer overflow-hidden wrapper around Compact is an explicit mutation and is killed with observation-clipped-by-ancestor.

Implementation I3b is repaired. The standalone manifest verifier now verifies reproducible source and output entries against actual bytes, recomputes sourceSetDigest, and requires the reproducible arrays to equal the canonical projection derived from the verified artifact. Reauthenticated false source-set, reproducible-only source-hash, and reproducible-only output-hash mutations are all killed.

Science S2 is repaired. Inference is visibly declared a display alias; the exact state is External(SourceConsistentInference). Unranked is External(Unranked). Row normalization is scoped to this synthetic fixture, while the underlying alignment contract remains unbalanced-capable.

Science S3 is repaired from one ordinal ledger. The source has exactly 117 eligible lexical tokens: 92 observed and 25 missing. The selected 25-token window has 21 observed and 4 missing. Sentence, window, and whole-track values are all derived from that ledger and the conservation mutation is killed. Exact vocabulary is EdgePolicy.KeepPartial, ScalarReducer.Mean, IgnoreMissing, MissingReason.AllMissing, and MissingReason.ProviderAbstained.

Science S4 is repaired without inventing provider vocabulary. Unestablished is plainly labelled proposed-storyatlas-view-state@v1, and the plates say the pinned provider has no such type yet.

Science S5 is repaired. The s02/s09 link is now reported content plus opposite-polarity recurrence; identity and persistence are unestablished. The unsupported s03-before-s04 order is gone and those events occupy an explicit incomparable band. Main now exposes 37 field-addressable claims covering all 10 selections. Every upstream claim ID resolves, alternatives are separate claims, exact source spans round-trip, and the claim-support mutation is killed. Coreference, return completion, and intentional withholding are no longer promoted to source-explicit facts.

Exact evidence now registered on the candidate

- Git ancestry passes and the commit is a direct child of the declared base.
- Artifact integrity passes: 25 authenticated sources, 29 outputs, 25 reproducible sources, 14 reproducible outputs. Artifact digest 3dd04832dbbe9a3501f5af3048378a62d9809362aa10e04164ac550835dca9e8; reproducible digest d3a378c3444d3e6d435ba6b1f9e4663499be52a895bb03fb9b0f13d5f84a5530.
- The exact headless build command compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS passed. Test total: 113 across layout JVM/JS, Intaglio JVM/JS, CLI, and app.
- All 13 frozen plates remain standalone HTML/CSS with no scripts, active event semantics, external resources, or network dependencies. The successful generation had clean browser-ownership audits before and after.
- The renderer court remains deliberately bounded: 2300 marks rendered as ten explicit segments exceed both the 10000-element and 2-MiB gates, while a shared pattern passes. This supports Intaglio for prototype or small fallback geometry and identifies a reusable paint/pattern abstraction as the production gap; it does not condemn or certify a renderer wholesale.

One later unprivileged renderer-benchmark recheck failed before page creation because sandboxed Chromium exited with SIGTRAP. It changed no candidate byte, is not being counted as evidence, and the required post-failure ownership audit found no automated top-level browser process.

Relationship to the output-format epic and O3

This static mockup does not settle graph-over-text. It demonstrates a credible Codex rail, typed portal endpoints, relation inventories, and a sibling Atlas, but static plates cannot establish whether cross-page causal and world-time navigation works well enough in practice. Chief has correctly ruled O3 as a two-condition spike with a required unattended design court and an optional, separately governed human study. The candidate should therefore be reviewed as design evidence for that spike, not as the spike result or as permission to implement the output epic.

Fresh review requested from:
- codex-mockup-implementation-review: re-test I2b/I3b and the full artifact boundary.
- codex-mockup-science-review: re-test S2-S5, especially typed vocabulary, chronology, claims, alternatives, and exact spans.
- codex-mockup-ux-review: prior approval does not transfer; recheck the changed Main, Recall, StateBoard, and Interview plates.

Landability is now blocked only by those three fresh reviews and absent Chief authorization.
